name: Spain
tagline: One accreditation, UNEDasiss, unlocks almost every Spanish university
ownCitizens: If you hold Spanish citizenship, the parts of this page written for other EU/EEA citizens — registering your right of residence, proving your fee status — are not about you, and Spain's own student grants and loans are open to you on their ordinary terms; check them, because some depend on where you have lived. Your IB is still a foreign qualification here, so the IB entry rules on this page still apply to you.
summary: Public universities in Spain admit an IB student through one accreditation, UNEDasiss, which turns the Diploma into a Spanish grade out of 10 (14 with extra subject tests), and then rank applicants in a regional preinscripción that closes in early July. Public fees are low, about €1,000–€1,250 a year at Carlos III. Most English-taught bachelors are at private universities such as IE, which run their own rounds from the autumn before.
whyConsider: The IB Diploma needs no homologation: it gives access on the same terms as a Spanish Bachillerato.
Public fees are low: €16.92–€20.68 per credit at Carlos III in 2026/27, for EU students.
Real English-taught options in Madrid and Barcelona, and private universities that decide on predicted grades.
watchOuts: The public-university deadline is early July — 7 July in 2026, the day after IB results — not the 1 December end of the UNEDasiss window.
The May PCE subject tests, which lift your grade above 10, come the week straight after the IB exams end.
Private universities (IE, Navarra, ESADE, Deusto, Comillas) close rounds from September of the year before and charge far more.

ibRecognition.gradeConversion: UNEDasiss converts the IB into an access grade of 5 to 10. Universities can add up to 4 points from weighted subject tests (PCE), to a maximum of 14.
notes: IB Diploma holders are exempt from the Spanish access test, like holders of a Spanish Técnico Superior title.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Concentrated in a handful of universities — IE, Carlos III, Pompeu Fabra, Navarra, ESADE, Autònoma de Barcelona, Deusto, Comillas.
notes: In Catalonia and the Basque Country, some modules may be taught in Catalan or Basque. Check each module.

feeContext.summary: Public universities charge per credit at a regionally set price: at Carlos III in 2026/27, €16.92–€20.68 per credit, about €1,015–€1,241 for a 60-credit year. Private universities set their own, much higher, fees.

Set by each region and university. At Carlos III in 2026/27, non-EU students without Spanish resident status pay €113.71–€136.44 per credit, about €6,823–€8,186 for a 60-credit year. A study permit does not count as residence.

sectorLandscape.summary: Degrees (grados) are taught at universidades, public or private. Alongside them sit two-year Técnico Superior courses in vocational training (FP de grado superior) and in plastic arts and design, and the Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores at conservatorios and schools of art and design.

routes.what: Four-year grado. Admission by rank on the UNEDasiss grade in a regional preinscripción; low per-credit fees.
IE, Navarra, ESADE, Deusto, Comillas and others. Own tests, interviews and rolling rounds from the autumn before; much higher fees. Where most English-taught bachelors are.
Two-year practical courses with a work placement, and a recognised route on into a university degree. The Spanish route foreigners are rarely told about.
routes.note: Not covered here; see the ministry's FP portal, todofp.es.

routes.what: Music, dance, drama, design and conservation at conservatorios and escuelas superiores, with their own entrance tests.

jurisdictions.name: Public universities — UNEDasiss, then preinscripción
jurisdictions.summary: UNEDasiss accreditation, then the preinscripción of the region or university. Ranked on the grade out of 14.

variations.label: Deadlines
variations.summary: Catalonia runs one preinscripció for all its public universities. Elsewhere each university's preinscripción applies; most close in early July, some earlier.

jurisdictions.name: Private universities — direct
jurisdictions.summary: Applied to directly, in rounds from the autumn before entry, with a test and interview and a conditional offer on predicted grades.

notes: Institution jurisdictions to add to data/countries/es.json on publishing: es-private = IE, Navarra, ESADE, Deusto, Comillas, CEU San Pablo; es-public = UC3M, UPF, UAB, UAM, UB, UCM, UPC.

Not established: 2027 PCE and preinscripción dates, private-university fees other than Esade's (BBA €21,300 for 2027/28), and whether FP de grado superior and Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores accept an IB Diploma.
